title: ValueMate Studio Verified by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to Support UAD 3.6
summary: As of August 10, ValueMate Studio is verified by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to support the UAD 3.6 specifications.
body_markdown:
As of August 10, 2026, ValueMate Studio has been verified by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to support the Uniform Appraisal Dataset (UAD) 3.6 specifications.


This verification means appraisers can use ValueMate Studio to complete and deliver reports under the redesigned standard. It also marks an important milestone in our work to make the transition to UAD 3.6 simpler for appraisal professionals.


## What verification means


ValueMate Studio is now included on Fannie Mae's Integrated Vendor List and Freddie Mac's Software Providers List. Appraisers working in Studio can complete reports that conform to the UAD 3.6 specifications and prepare them for submission through the Uniform Collateral Data Portal® (UCDP®).


Beginning November 2, 2026, all new appraisal reports submitted to UCDP must conform to the new standard. ValueMate Studio is available today, giving appraisers time to learn the workflow and make the transition before that date.


## A redesigned appraisal report


UAD 3.6 introduces a redesigned Uniform Residential Appraisal Report. Instead of maintaining separate reports across 14 legacy forms, the new standard consolidates them into a single, dynamic report.


That change affects much more than the final document. It changes how property information is collected, organized, validated, and delivered. ValueMate Studio was built around that complete workflow rather than treating UAD 3.6 as another form added to legacy software.


> “We are grateful to the teams at Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac for a thorough process. Appraisers working in Studio can complete the redesigned report today. Between now and November, our focus is on helping our customers move to the new standard smoothly.” — Anir Prativadi, co-founder and chief executive officer of ValueMate


ValueMate Studio is available now.
